## berth mcp

an MCP server, for an agent to manage orgs through typed tools

### Synopsis

A Model Context Protocol server on stdin and stdout, for a local client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop).

It is read-only unless told otherwise: an agent can list hosts and orgs, read status, logs, the
firewall, repos, variable names, packages and backups.
  --allow-writes    also firewall allow/deny, repo add/remove, and taking backups
  --allow-restarts  also starting, restarting and stopping orgs, each call confirmed with the org's name
Secret values are never returned, and every change asked for is in the state root's audit.log.
docs/guides/mcp.md has the setup for Claude Code and Claude Desktop.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_mcp/

```
berth mcp [--allow-writes] [--allow-restarts] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth mcp
  berth mcp --allow-writes
  claude mcp add berth -- berth mcp
```

### Options

```
      --allow-restarts   let tools start, restart and stop orgs too (implies --allow-writes)
      --allow-writes     let tools change orgs (firewall, repos, backups)
  -h, --help             help for mcp
```
